pl-l4d45c5-d1e115.summary: Asks about a moderately good person, needing suffrages, who dies at the very consummation of the world with the rest, if he is to be saved: no further sacrifice, prayer, or alms is offered for him, and he lacked merits so perfect as not to need them; will he be saved?

pl-l4d45c5-d1e118.summary: Answers that he thinks such a person is saved, as passing through fire, by the merits and intercessions of the heavenly Church, which always intercedes for the faithful by will and merit until Christ is fulfilled.
claims: The heavenly Church's intercession saves such a person.

pl-l4d45c5.summary: Asks about a moderately good person needing suffrages who dies at the very end of the world, when no more sacrifice, prayer, or alms will be offered: will he be saved? Lombard thinks he will be saved as through fire by the merits and intercession of the heavenly Church, which always intercedes for the faithful until Christ is fulfilled.
claims: Those dying at the world's end are helped by the heavenly Church's intercession.
